topics.label: Faithful reproduction
topics.rule: The ad claims that the instrument reproduces the artist's playing exactly, faithfully, truly or perfectly, or that what one hears is the artist's actual/original playing.

examples.quote: The Welte gives the absolutely true reproduction of the interpretation of the World's Most Famous Pianists.
EN ABSOLUT TRO GJENGIVELSE AV VERDENSBERØMTE PIANISTER'S PERSONLIGE SPIL
examples.gloss: an absolutely true reproduction of world-famous pianists' personal playing

topics.label: Nuance, touch and expressive detail
topics.rule: Names specific performance parameters that are reproduced (touch/attack, dynamics, shading/nuance, phrasing, pedalling, tempo, rhythm, accent, tone colour) or claims that even the finest shadings / smallest details are preserved.

examples.quote: återgifver det karaktäristiska hos hvarje pianist, hans anslag, nyansering, tempo- och pedalbehandling
examples.gloss: reproduces what is characteristic of each pianist: his touch, nuancing, tempo and pedalling

examples.quote: Every shade and degree of accent, rhythm, and tone is duplicated perfectly and exactly as the Artist rendered it—nothing is added, nothing lost.

topics.label: Individuality, personality and soul
topics.rule: Claims that the artist's individuality, personal style, character, personality, feelings or soul are captured, i.e. the reproduction is personal and not merely the notes.

examples.quote: The Welte-Mignon Autograph Piano Is the Living Soul of the Artist
vermag dieses Wunderklavier alles, was an der Leistung eines Künstlers das Persönliche und Charakteristische ausmacht, zur Geltung zu bringen
examples.gloss: this wonder-piano can bring out everything that makes an artist's performance personal and characteristic

topics.label: Illusion of presence
topics.rule: Claims that the listener would believe the artist is physically present at the piano, cannot tell reproduction from live playing, or recognises at once who is playing ('as if he sat at your piano', 'close your eyes', 'deceives even the artists').

examples.quote: Schliesst man :-: die Augen, so ist die Täuschung vollkommen.
examples.gloss: If one closes one's eyes, the illusion is complete.

examples.quote: you have but to close your eyes to feel the pres-ence of the master at the keys.

topics.label: Beyond the mechanical
topics.rule: Explicitly denies that the playing is mechanical, or contrasts it with 'mechanical', automatic or earlier self-playing instruments in terms of life, warmth, soul or artistry (living, human, no cold regularity, not a surrogate).

examples.quote: Welte-Mignon spielt menschlich, deshalb künstlerisch. Ihm haftet nichts von der kalten Regelmässigkeit eines automatischen Klaviers an.
examples.gloss: Welte-Mignon plays humanly, therefore artistically. It has nothing of the cold regularity of an automatic piano.

examples.quote: This instrument faithfully reflects the master's technique without the slightest indication of mechanical blemish.

topics.label: Endorsement by great musicians
topics.rule: Quotes or reports praise or approval by named musicians (pianists, composers, conductors), or claims in general that the great artists praise, recommend or have 'pronounced it perfect'.

examples.quote: Das Welte Mignon ist das Wunder der Wunder. Carreno.
examples.gloss: The Welte Mignon is the wonder of wonders. (Carreño)

examples.quote: The Welte-Mignon was the first reproducing mechanism pronounced perfect by the greatest artists.

topics.label: Artists hear themselves
topics.rule: A recording artist hears, recognises or authenticates his or her own reproduced playing (hearing oneself for the first time, 'know thyself', rolls signed as true autographs, Grieg recognising his own touch).

examples.quote: Es ciertamente la primera vez que puedo decir que me he oído a mí mismo
examples.gloss: It is certainly the first time that I can say I have heard myself (Pugno)

examples.quote: Wie erstaunlich und tief ergreifend ist es, sein vor Jahren aufgenommenes Spiel in größter Vollendung durch "Welte-Mignon" wiedergegeben zu hören!
examples.gloss: How astonishing and deeply moving it is to hear one's playing, recorded years ago, reproduced in the greatest perfection by the Welte-Mignon! (d'Albert)

topics.label: Star pianists foregrounded
topics.rule: One or a few named virtuosi are made the centrepiece of the ad (headline name, portrait or photograph, biographical praise, anecdote), going beyond a mere list of names.

examples.quote: No living pianist has done more to engender a love for music among American people than Josef Hofmann
PADEREWSKI, “El Coloso” Y LA “WELTE-MIGNON”
examples.gloss: Paderewski, 'the Colossus', and the Welte-Mignon (with engraved portrait and facsimile signature)

topics.label: Composers at the keyboard
topics.rule: Stresses that composers (not only virtuosi) recorded for the instrument, especially playing their own works; includes concert programmes that mark a composer as performer of his own piece.

examples.quote: Kom in och låt oss spela en komposition av Sjögren eller Stenhammar, inspelade av kompositörerna själva.
examples.gloss: Come in and let us play a composition by Sjögren or Stenhammar, recorded by the composers themselves.

examples.quote: (Executat per son autor)
examples.gloss: (performed by its author) - said of Granados' Goyescas in the programme

topics.label: Public recognition: awards, institutions, press, world renown
topics.rule: Invokes recognition by juries, institutions, press/critics or 'the world': exhibition medals and prizes, purchase or use by conservatories and ministries, press verdicts, 'world-famous', 'known the world over', sensation abroad, a triumphal progress through the world.

examples.quote: Das Reproduktions-Piano WelteMignon wurde soeben vom k. k. österreichischen Ministerium für Kultus und Unterricht zu pädagogischen Zwecken für das Wiener Konservatorium angekauft. Ein glänzender Beweis
examples.gloss: The Welte-Mignon reproducing piano has just been bought by the Austrian Ministry of Culture and Education for the Vienna Conservatory for teaching purposes. A brilliant proof

examples.quote: MEDALLAS DE ORO con que han sido premiados en las distintas Exposiciones los famosos pianos “WELTE MIGNON”
examples.gloss: Gold medals with which the famous Welte Mignon pianos have been awarded at the various exhibitions

topics.label: Royal and aristocratic patronage
topics.rule: Associates the instrument with royalty, nobility or the court: royal owners and listeners, court-supplier warrants (of maker or dealer), imperial emblems, aristocratic gatherings.

examples.quote: dass der verewigte Grossherzog Friedrich I. und Ihre Königliche Hoheit die Grossherzogin Luise gelegentlich Höchst ihres letzten gemeinsamen Sommeraufenthalts auf Schloss Baden im vergangenen Jahr das von Ihnen gelieferte „Welte-Mignon“-Klavier sich täglich haben vorspielen lassen
examples.gloss: that the late Grand Duke Friedrich I and Her Royal Highness Grand Duchess Luise, during their last summer stay together at Baden Castle, had the Welte-Mignon piano you supplied play for them daily

examples.quote: the German Emperor ordered a WelteMignon Autograph Piano for his steam yacht.

topics.label: Owners' testimonials and social proof
topics.rule: Gives voice to, or counts, satisfied owners and lay listeners (not recording artists speaking as such): owner quotes ('That's why I bought it'), customers' letters, numbers of instruments placed or of families owning one.

examples.quote: "Unbelievably True to the Artist's Playing— That's why I bought it"
bajo el mismo juicio de más de DIEZ MIL familias, que en esta República poseen estos pianos
examples.gloss: under the same judgement as more than ten thousand families in this Republic who own these pianos

topics.group: Time: immortality and the lost past
topics.label: Preserved for posterity
topics.rule: The playing is preserved forever or for future generations, made immortal or imperishable ('Instrument of the Immortals'); includes deceased or retired artists who can still be heard.

examples.quote: the Welte-Mignon caught the great masters in the act of playing, and fixed their style for ever.
Was grosse Meister unserer Tage leisten, kann nun nicht mehr untergehen und spätere Generationen werden die Früchte dieser genialen Erfindung geniessen.
examples.gloss: What the great masters of our day achieve can now no longer perish, and later generations will enjoy the fruits of this ingenious invention.

topics.group: Time: immortality and the lost past
topics.label: If only it had existed earlier
topics.rule: Regret that the invention came too late to preserve the playing of past masters (Beethoven, Mozart, Chopin, Liszt, Rubinstein, Bülow ...).

examples.quote: Man maa kun beklage at denne Opfindelse ikke allerede blev gjort tidligere; thi da kunde vi endnu den Dag i Dag høre Beethoven, Mozart og Chopin selv spille
examples.gloss: One can only regret that this invention was not made earlier; for then we could still today hear Beethoven, Mozart and Chopin play themselves

examples.quote: The regret of musicians must ever be that this great invention was not brought out in 1809 instead of 1909.

topics.label: Wonder and astonishment
topics.rule: Presents the instrument as a wonder, marvel or miracle (noun use, or an exclamation like 'Marvellous!') or reports astonishment or disbelief at it. Plain attributive adjectives ('wonderful', 'marvellous', 'wunderbar') alone do not count.

examples.quote: Es ist ein wahres Wunder der Welt.
examples.gloss: It is a true wonder of the world.

examples.quote: Den som hört det, står stum inför detta under
examples.gloss: Whoever has heard it stands speechless before this wonder

topics.label: Phantom hands and the supernatural
topics.rule: Supernatural or uncanny imagery: phantom or ghost hands, spirits, magic and wizardry, conjuring, a 'sensation of fear', keys moving with no one at the piano; includes illustrations of semi-transparent hands or figures, or of a piano playing with nobody seated at it.

examples.quote: These are the PhantomHands of a thousandimmortal pianists
WATCH the keys of your piano moving, though no one sits before it!

topics.label: Epoch-making invention and progress
topics.rule: Frames the instrument as an invention (epoch-making, ingenious, sensational, newest) or as a step in, or the culmination of, technical development (latest novelty, new model, patents, 'after many inventions and many failures').

examples.quote: The science of musical reproduction has progressed through the various stages–experiment, mediocrity, excellence–but until the introduction of the Welte-Mignon it has never reached supreme perfection.
„Welte Mignon“ anses som det mest epokegørende Kunstspilleapparat, der findes
examples.gloss: 'Welte Mignon' is regarded as the most epoch-making art-playing device in existence

topics.label: How it works: mechanism, recording, media analogies
topics.rule: Explains the mechanism, operation or recording process (roll, pneumatics, motor, valves, controls, 'photographic' recording, reproduction made directly on the piano), or compares the instrument with photography or the phonograph.

examples.quote: ein akustisches Seitenstück zur Platte des Photo-graphen
examples.gloss: an acoustic counterpart to the photographer's plate

examples.quote: Der Mechanismus wird von einer Notenrolle, dem Gehirn des Apparates, gelenkt.
examples.gloss: The mechanism is guided by a music roll, the brain of the apparatus.

topics.label: Masters in your home
topics.rule: Locates the experience in the buyer's private home: the great pianists play in or for your home, on your own piano, house concerts; or the instrument is explicitly destined for the private home (incl. the slogan 'The Master's Fingers on Your Piano').

examples.quote: byder Muligheden at høre Verdens første Pianister i Ens eget Hjem
examples.gloss: offers the possibility of hearing the world's foremost pianists in one's own home

examples.quote: Pendant les VACANCES pour avoir des CONCERTS chez soi
examples.gloss: During the holidays, to have concerts at home

topics.label: At your command
topics.rule: Stresses the listener's control over when and what: at any time, as often as one likes, free choice of artist or piece, summoning artists ('zitieren', 'summon', 'at your beck and call').

examples.quote: He will play again, again and yet again for you tonight, tomorrow night and other nights in your own home.
Ein Druck auf den Knopf genügt, um einen d'Albert, Busoni, Paderewski, Reisenauer etc. zu zitieren.
examples.gloss: One press of the button is enough to summon a d'Albert, Busoni, Paderewski, Reisenauer etc.

topics.label: Effortless: no skill, push of a button
topics.rule: Ease of use or no need for musical skill or effort: the press of a button, no preparation, 'without human help', electric drive instead of pedalling, plugging into a light socket, no rerolling.

examples.quote: paa hvilket De kan spille fuldstændig kunstnerisk uden nogensomhelst Forberedelse
examples.gloss: on which you can play completely artistically without any preparation whatsoever

examples.quote: a person with no musical skill can have the actual playing of Paderewski, Hofmann, Rachmaninoff

topics.label: Entertaining guests
topics.rule: The instrument as an aid to hospitality and social occasions (guests, the hostess, dinner, parties, social functions), or illustrations of a social group (three or more adults, usually in evening dress) listening.

examples.quote: An ideal Instrument for homes where frequent social functions demand much entertaining, the WELTE will interest your guests and relieve the strain of hospitality.
Ihre Gäste sind ganz entzückt
examples.gloss: Your guests are quite delighted

topics.label: Private leisure and the hearth
topics.rule: Intimate, relaxed domestic listening: fireside, family, an evening at home, the easy chair, privacy, 'companionship'; includes illustrations of a family, a couple or a lone listener at ease.

examples.quote: Let a soft breeze slip through the window . . . rest at ease in a big Morris chair . . . and let the greatest musicians satisfy your soul with beautiful sound.
That delightful hour just after dinner—when the family is gathered around a cheery log fire

topics.label: Distinction and refinement
topics.rule: Ownership as a mark of status, culture or refinement: the 'distinguished' or cultured home, a token of culture, pride of possession, aristocratic settings.

examples.quote: Ihre Kunst verewigt im vornehmen Heim
examples.gloss: Their art immortalised in the distinguished home

examples.quote: Uno de estos instrumentos en su hogar, es una representación evidente de su cultura musical.
examples.gloss: One of these instruments in your home is evident proof of your musical culture.

topics.label: Instrument as furniture
topics.rule: The appearance and design of the instrument as furniture or decor: elegant case, an ornament for the salon, period styles, case woods and designs; includes illustrations placing the instrument in a period interior.

examples.quote: Ved sit elegante Ydre en Pryd for enhver Salon.
examples.gloss: With its elegant exterior an ornament for every drawing room.

examples.quote: in the following period models FLORENTINE GRANDGEORGIAN WELTE-MIGNON LOUIS XVI GRANDLOUIS XV WELTE-MIGNON COLONIAL

topics.label: Abundant and varied repertoire
topics.rule: Stresses the size or breadth of the music available: thousands of rolls, a comprehensive library, the whole range of composition, classics as well as popular music, music for every mood and occasion.

examples.quote: the incomparable WELTEMIGNON Library of over three thousand Master Recordings . . . classical music, modern music , orchestral music, ballets and dance ... a program to suit every mood and occasion.
der kan erholdes et Repertoire omfattende saavel alle Klassikerne indspillet af Verdens betydeligste Virtuoser, som Øjeblikkets kendte og populære Danse
examples.gloss: a repertoire can be had comprising all the classics recorded by the world's most important virtuosi as well as the well-known popular dances of the moment

topics.label: Dance and popular music
topics.rule: Offers dance music, popular hits or jazz, or presents the instrument as the provider of music for dancing (incl. ballet accompaniment and dance pieces such as the tango).

examples.quote: After dinner comes dancing, perhaps on the veranda, with the Welte-Mignon providing the newest and most popular dance hits, played by a hundred masters of jazz.
or perhaps a delightful impromptu dance, with the Welte-Mignon to furnish the music.

topics.label: Evocative scenes and moods
topics.rule: Vivid word- or picture-painting of what the music conjures up (a storm at sea, a Gaucho dance, Valkyries, an old garden), its moods and memories, or an emotional narrative of the listening experience.

examples.quote: As the old strains come forth, time slips back to a garden of days gone by.
The wild rhythm of a mazurka, the lure of a Venetian love lyric, the poignant charm of a simple plantation melody, assume a new beauty when formed under the hands of a master.

topics.label: Seasons, holidays and gifts
topics.rule: Ties the purchase or the listening to a season or occasion: a Christmas present, the New Year, summer, holidays, winter evenings.

examples.quote: das denkbar vornehmste Weihnachtsgeschenk!
examples.gloss: the most distinguished Christmas present imaginable!

examples.quote: Summertime,-at home!

topics.label: Pedagogical value
topics.rule: Educational use: studying the masters' interpretations, lessons, students and teachers, conservatories and music schools.

examples.quote: The Welte-Mignon can be likened to a college for teaching the art of playing the piano.
Neben seiner hohen künstlerischen Bedeutung hat WelteMignon auch einen eminent pädagogischen Wert
examples.gloss: Besides its high artistic importance, the Welte-Mignon also has an eminent pedagogical value

topics.label: Cultural uplift and art for all
topics.rule: Art music made accessible to the wide public or to humanity, or the instrument presented as morally and culturally elevating entertainment.

examples.quote: Musikalische Unterhaltung edelster Art bringt Welte-Mignon.
examples.gloss: Welte-Mignon brings musical entertainment of the noblest kind.

examples.quote: halte ich „Mignon“ ganz besonders dazu geeignet, vollendet künstlerische Musik in den weitesten Kreisen populär zu machen
examples.gloss: I consider the Mignon especially suited to making perfectly artistic music popular in the widest circles (Grünfeld)

topics.label: Within reach: affordability and value
topics.rule: Argues that the instrument is attainable or good value (within everyone's means, easily yours, the price of an ordinary player piano, worth more than it costs). Bare prices and payment terms are functional, not this topic.

examples.quote: Marvellous—yes . . . out of your reach—emphatically, no!
We maintain that if music is to be enjoyed by everyone, it must be within everyone's reach.

topics.label: Quality and durability
topics.rule: Build quality, reliability and longevity: tested in every climate, tropical construction, years of trouble-free service, warnings against cheap or 'jerry-built' instruments, highest-quality manufacture.

examples.quote: The Man who Buys a Jerry-Built House —— lives to regret it
Erprobt in jedem Klima.
examples.gloss: Tested in every climate.

topics.label: Compatibility and versatility
topics.rule: The mechanism fits the buyer's or any piano, is available in many makes, is installed invisibly, leaves manual playing intact, or offers several modes of playing.

examples.quote: The Welte-Mignon* is invisible and does not interfere with manual playing. It is obtainable in practically every good make of piano
kan op vier verschillende manieren bespeeld worden
examples.gloss: can be played in four different ways

topics.label: Uses beyond the home
topics.rule: Names uses outside private listening: accompaniment for singers or ballet, stage and theatre, concert halls, hotels, restaurants, clubs, hospitals, sanatoria.

examples.quote: För hem, konsertsalonger, musikinstitut, sjukhus, sanatorier, klubblokaler, förstkl. restauranger
examples.gloss: For homes, concert salons, music institutes, hospitals, sanatoria, club rooms, first-class restaurants

examples.quote: Many recordings by notable accompanists afford competent support for singing at any time.

topics.label: Superlatives
topics.rule: Claims that the instrument is the best, finest, most perfect, supreme, incomparable or unsurpassed, or the standard for all others.

examples.quote: Verdens fineste Kunstspilapparat
examples.gloss: The world's finest art-playing device

examples.quote: NO HAY NADA MEJOR, NI SE PUEDE PEDIR MAS
examples.gloss: There is nothing better, nor can one ask for more

topics.label: The only one
topics.rule: Claims uniqueness: the only instrument that reproduces faithfully, that has artistic standing or that possesses 'the secret'; the only one of its kind (in a country).

examples.quote: LE SEUL qui reproduise fidèlement le jeu des grands maîtres du clavier
examples.gloss: the only one that faithfully reproduces the playing of the great masters of the keyboard

examples.quote: Only Welte-Mignon*possesses this secret of perfect reproduction.

topics.label: Outclassing rivals; invitation to compare
topics.rule: Positions the instrument against competitors or other self-playing instruments (surpasses all others, has nothing in common with them, beware of cheap or unknown makes), or invites comparison and tests of the claims (hear it in comparison, try it, staged side-by-side demonstrations).

examples.quote: Why should you accept less when you can have a Welte-Mignon?
Chopins Ballad spelas af tvänne pianister för att framhålla ”Mignons” återgifvande af det individuella hos hvarje pianist.
examples.gloss: Chopin's Ballade is played by two pianists to bring out the Mignon's reproduction of what is individual in each pianist.

topics.label: The original: priority and Welte heritage
topics.rule: Claims priority or originality (first reproducing piano, original invention, first 'pronounced perfect') or invokes the history and tradition of the Welte firm (founded 1832, the clockmaker Michael Welte, Edwin Welte).

examples.quote: The first recording piano ever invented the Welte Mignon remains unchallenged as the world's greatest instrument of reproduction
La WELTE MIGNON CO. fué la primera fábrica en el mundo que construyó y construye pianos REPRODUCTORES
examples.gloss: The Welte Mignon Co. was the first factory in the world to build reproducing pianos, and still builds them

topics.label: National framing
topics.rule: Appeals to national pride or national musical life: national inventiveness or industry, the nation's own artists, a pianist's service to the nation's love of music.

examples.quote: Deutschem Erfindungsgeist ist es geglückt, eine geradezu phantastisch erscheinende Idee
examples.gloss: German inventive genius has succeeded in realising an idea that seems downright fantastic

examples.quote: les célébrités du monde musical viennent faire l’éloge de ce piano qui fait honneur au nom canadien
examples.gloss: the celebrities of the musical world come to praise this piano, which does honour to the Canadian name

topics.label: Allegorical and classical ornament
topics.rule: Illustrations using allegorical, mythological or classical emblems of music (muses, fauns with pan-pipes, lyre and laurel). Firm logos and seals do not count.

examples.quote: FIG: Drawing of a grand piano and a standard lamp, with three muses in flowing robes floating above them, one blowing a long trumpet
examples.gloss: (illustration description)

examples.quote: FIG: Framed panel: a faun playing pan-pipes
examples.gloss: (illustration description)

functional.label: Advertiser address / contact details (street, telephone, floor)
Prices, discounts and bargain / second-hand sales (explicit price figures or sale offers)
Payment terms, instalments and trade-in of the old piano
Invitations to hear / see the instrument at the showroom; daily or free demonstrations and auditions
Public concerts, recitals and scheduled demonstrations (dates, halls, programmes, tickets)
Artist rosters (three or more recording artists listed by name, incl. concert programmes)
Model names, product variants and host-piano makes (Vorsetzer/cabinet, Steinway-Welte, grand/upright, Musicalle, Quadrola, licensee makes, '115 makes')
Catalogues, brochures, programmes or literature offered
Firm credentials of dealer or maker (founding year, size, branches, court-supplier title)
